assumptions: The isolated pixel timing measures the component changed by this candidate. Nonpixel and live scheduling costs are held at that frame's original value. Native candidate timings and a new physical motion remain unmeasured here.
method: Each original sample/IK total is adjusted by the independently timed candidate-minus-baseline pixel duration for that exact immutable packet, paired within the same repetition. Quantiles are taken only after per-sample arithmetic. The same original dynamic sample is reused across timing replicates.
quantiles: Linear empirical quantile, ordered rank (n-1)*p. Untrimmed samples. Cycle, neighbors and combined bounds retained.
scope: offline candidate estimate paired to 70 original controller samples
